parts.text: Which conclusion about these topics is best?

options.text: They belong to different fields, yet they are connected ways of studying the same world.
Only the breathing topic is real science; shadows and day–night sit outside science.
Each topic sits in a sealed subject box, so materials ideas cannot help with light or the body.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Firoz studies four Class 7 topics in one week: how soap cleans oily hands, how exercise changes breathing, how a shadow grows longer near sunset, and why day and night follow each other.

part_answers.answer: Different fields still study the same world, so the topics connect rather than sit in sealed boxes.

teacher.key_rationale: Soap, breathing, shadows, and day–night belong to different fields but are connected ways of studying the same world.
